adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb the job iterates `rss.items.each` and performs per-item operations that can raise (e.g., `i.content.scrub` if `i.content` is nil, `open(...)`, or `TopicEmbed.import(...)`), but there is no per-item rescue. Any exception will abort the whole job and skip remaining items. Since `sidekiq_options retry: false` is set, the failed run will not be retried and processing is effectively deferred until the next hourly run, potentially repeatedly failing on the same problematic item.
